Simply sauté them in honey for a salty-sweet flavor!|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Glazed Veggies are made by [[Cooking]] any [[Vegetable]]s, herb, or [[Flower]] in a [[Cooking Pot]] with [[Courser Bee Honey]]. Regular Glazed Veggies can be made by using [[Ingredient]]s with a different effect than the Courser Bee Honey. When eaten, they will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. Glazed Veggies are Veggies sautéed with Honey for a salty-sweet flavor, which makes them ideal for those who dislike the taste of vegetables. Due to the limitations of their [[Recipe]], only one variation of Glazed Veggies exists: * '''Energizing Glazed Veggies''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Glazed Veggies}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Don't like the taste of vegetables? Simply sauté them in honey for a salty-sweet flavour.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hyrule Herb]]s, which doesn't have any effects. Consuming these Veggies will refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Glazed Meat * Glazed Mushrooms * Glazed Seafood * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
